IGUI_WQ_NoReclamable: This place can no longer be claimed
IGUI_WQ_Locura: %1 lost their mind and fled %2 with supplies
IGUI_WQ_Panel_SinTerritorio: You have no territories. Claim one with right click.
IGUI_WQ_Panel_Estructuras: Structures: %1 beds, %2 farm plots, %3 stoves, %4 generators
IGUI_WQ_Panel_Selecciona: Click a colonist to see their sheet
IGUI_WQ_Panel_Tirada: Narrator tension: %1 (next roll: %2 percent; rolls every %3 min)
IGUI_WQ_Pista_reclamar: Right-click the ground to claim a territory. Your colony starts there.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_almacen: Mark a piece of furniture with storage space as the colony storage: food and materials are kept there.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_colonos: Once you have a storage, survivors will come to your colony asking for shelter.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_roles: A colonist without a role does nothing. Give them one in the Colonists tab of the Command center.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_hambre: Your colonists are hungry. They eat whatever is in the storage.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_obras: Your builders can raise buildings. Check the Buildings tab.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_mejorar: You can upgrade your colony now. Check the Colony tab of the Command center.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_crisis: A crisis has been announced. The Command center shows how long until it arrives.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Mejorar: Upgrades the colony to the next level. Uses the materials in the storage.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Nivel: The size of your colony. Each level enlarges the territory and allows more colonists.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_DeOtro: This colony belongs to another player. You can look, but you can't give orders.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Cupo: Colonists in the colony and how many fit. Each bed adds a spot, up to the level's limit.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Comida: Food in the storages. Colonists eat from here.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Materiales: Planks, nails and logs in the storages. Spent on upgrades and buildings.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Estructuras: What is inside the territory. Beds raise the capacity; stoves and generators cheer colonists up; farm plots help the farmer.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Defensa: How well the colony holds against a raid. Raised by guards, each colonist's combat and some buildings.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Siguiente: To level up you need these materials in the storage and a minimum number of colonists.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_SinColonos: Survivors come to colonies that have a storage and free space.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Animo: If it reaches zero, the colonist leaves. It rises when they eat well and drops with hunger.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Rol: What they do each cycle: the farmer harvests, the builder gathers logs or raises buildings, the scout brings loot at a risk, the guard defends and the doctor cheers people up.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Hambre: Time without food. If it continues, they lose mood and end up leaving.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Habilidades: They improve by working in their role. The highlighted one is their specialty.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Construir: Starts the building and spends its materials right away. Builders raise it.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_EnObra: Progresses every cycle depending on your builders. Without builders, it stops.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Proyecto_torre: Warns earlier about announced crises and adds defense.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Proyecto_taller: Builders gather twice the logs and also salvage scrap.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Proyecto_muralla: Shrinks hordes and adds a lot of defense.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Proyecto_radio: Attracts more survivors asking for shelter.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Tension: Each roll without a crisis raises the tension and the chance of the next one. It grows with the size of the largest colony.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Pendiente: An announced crisis. Get ready before it arrives.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Frio: Dangerous cold inside the territory. Dress warmly or find heat.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_AbrirMapa: Opens the world map centered on this colony.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_FilaMapa: Click to see it on the map.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_SinPistas: The tips that appear while you play are kept here.
IGUI_WQ_YaTienesFaccion: You already belong to a faction.
IGUI_WQ_FaccionNombreUsado: There is already a faction called %1.
IGUI_WQ_LiderDesconectado: The leader of %1 is not online.
IGUI_WQ_SolicitudEnviada: You asked the leader of %1 to accept you.
IGUI_WQ_LiderNoSale: The leader can't leave while there are other members.
IGUI_WQ_SinFaccion: Create or join a faction first.
IGUI_WQ_SolicitudRecibida: %1 wants to join your faction. Accept?
IGUI_WQ_FaccionDesc_leales: Strong: territory defense. Minor: discipline, they rarely go mad. Weakness: they consume more and mercenaries distrust them.
IGUI_WQ_FaccionDesc_comuna: Strong: food production. Minor: high morale. Weakness: weak in combat.
IGUI_WQ_FaccionDesc_chatarreros: Strong: fast construction. Minor: more wood and metal. Weakness: they produce little food.
IGUI_WQ_FaccionDesc_caravana: Strong: trade and safe caravans. Minor: mercenaries like them. Weakness: few territories.
IGUI_WQ_FaccionDesc_carroneros: Strong: looting and raids. Minor: extra loot on expeditions. Weakness: bad reputation with everyone.
IGUI_WQ_FaccionDesc_devotos: Strong: they attract colonists. Minor: they rarely go mad. Weakness: slow economy.
IGUI_WQ_FaccionDesc_moteros: Strong: fast caravans, expeditions and raids. Minor: tough mercenaries respect them. Weakness: fragile bases.
IGUI_WQ_FaccionDesc_preppers: Strong: they withstand sieges, with big storages and food that doesn't rot. Weakness: they grow slowly and are reluctant to accept colonists.
IGUI_WQ_FaccionDesc_fugados: Strong: melee combat, no fear of hordes. Minor: criminals and shady mercenaries like them. Weakness: poor discipline, fights and madness.
IGUI_WQ_FV_SinFacciones: There are no factions in this game yet.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_CrearFaccion: Creates the faction with you as its leader. Your territories become the faction's.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Unirse: Asks the leader to accept you. They have to be online.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_SalirFaccion: You leave the faction. If you are the last one, it dissolves and its territories become yours again.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_SinFaccion: Without a faction you can't claim territories. Create one or ask to join another.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Lider: Accepts new members. The only one who can't leave while there are others.
IGUI_WQ_Panel_SinFaccion: You don't belong to any faction yet.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_faccion: Before claiming territories you need a faction. Create one or join one from the Command center.
IGUI_WQ_MaxTerritorios: Your faction already has the maximum of %1 territories.
IGUI_WQ_Panel_SinRasgo: Your faction has no leader trait yet. Choose one:
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Efectos: What your faction and its leader's trait change. Green helps, red hurts.
IGUI_WQ_PuestoFuera: The command post has to be in a territory of your faction.
IGUI_WQ_PuestoSinComida: There is no food left in the storage for the command post.
IGUI_WQ_Alimentado: The colonists brought me food (%1 kcal)
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Puesto: The leader marks it with a right-click in their base. While nearby and hungry, colonists bring food from the storage.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_puesto: As leader, mark a command post in your base with a right-click: colonists bring you food there.
IGUI_WQ_Mando_DefenderFuera: They can only defend a spot inside their territory.
IGUI_WQ_Mando_MaxEscuadras: Your faction already has the maximum of %1 squads.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_GuardarEscuadra: Saves the selection with a name so you can pick it with one click. The same name replaces it.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_mando: Your colonists show up on the map. Click or use Shift + drag to select them, and right-click to give orders.
IGUI_WQ_ObraFuera: The building has to be inside the territory.
IGUI_WQ_ObraElige: Where does the building go? Click to choose, right-click to cancel.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_ElegirLugar: The building doesn't progress until you choose its spot. Use this button and click on the ground, or right-click on the map inside your territory.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_ubicar: The building is waiting for you to choose its spot: Choose spot button in the Buildings tab, or right-click on the map.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Recurso_comida: Calories of the non-rotten food in your storages. Colonists eat from here.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Recurso_madera: Planks and logs (a log is worth 3). Spent on levels and works.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Recurso_metal: Nails, screws, scrap, sheets and parts. Spent on levels and works.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Recurso_medicina: Bandages, pills and disinfectant. Worth a lot in barter.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Recurso_municion: Bullets and shells. Trade goods and defense.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Recurso_cigarros: Not a resource, but everyone takes them in barter.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Riqueza: What the base is worth: stored resources, level, works and colonists.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Especialidad: A base specializes on its own based on what it has and who works there.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Esp_fortin: Tower or wall and two guards: defense +15%.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Esp_taller: Workshop and a builder: more wood and metal.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Esp_granja: Many crops or two farmers: more food.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Esp_hospital: A medic and four beds: more mood and more bandages.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Entregas: What arrived while nobody was near. It goes into the storage once the base is loaded.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Viajes: Expeditions and other trips of your faction. You can see them on the map.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Expedicion: Pick colonists on the map, right click away from your base and send them. They bring loot, but may not come back.
IGUI_WQ_ExpedicionPerdio: %1 did not come back from the expedition
IGUI_WQ_ExpedicionVolvio: The expedition came back to %1 with %2
IGUI_WQ_ExpedicionVacia: The expedition came back to %1 empty-handed
IGUI_WQ_ExpedicionSinColonos: Pick colonists from a single base who are not traveling.
IGUI_WQ_ExpedicionCerca: That is inside your base. Pick a point outside.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_expedicion: You can send colonists on expeditions: pick them on the map and right click away from your base.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Estado_guerra: They can attack, raid and ambush caravans.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Estado_neutral: Neither friends nor enemies. Attacking first needs a declaration of war.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Estado_pacto: They can trade and their caravans are safe from each other.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Estado_alianza: They trade, see each other on the map and cannot attack each other.
IGUI_WQ_Dipl_SoloLider: Only the faction leader handles diplomacy.
IGUI_WQ_Dipl_NoValida: That proposal makes no sense with the current state.
IGUI_WQ_Dipl_GuerraReciente: The war is too recent: wait %1 minutes to ask for peace.
IGUI_WQ_Dipl_YaPropuesto: You already sent that proposal. Wait for the answer.
IGUI_WQ_Dipl_CasusBelli: %1 refused the tribute: for %2 minutes you can declare war without losing reputation.
IGUI_WQ_Dipl_TributoRecibido: Tribute from %1: %2 (it goes to your storage)
IGUI_WQ_Dipl_TributoSinRecursos: Could not pay the tribute (%1): not enough in a loaded base.
IGUI_WQ_Dipl_TributoFallo: %1 accepted, but could not pay the tribute.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Tributo: Offering raises your reputation. Demanding and being refused gives you a reason for war.
IGUI_WQ_Dipl_ConfirmarGuerra: Declare war on %1? If you had a deal, your reputation drops.
IGUI_WQ_Dipl_ConfirmarRomper: Break the deal with %1? Your reputation drops.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Dipl_Pacto: Proposes a trade pact: trade and safe caravans.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Dipl_Alianza: Proposes an alliance: trade, shared map and no attacks.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Dipl_Guerra: Declares war. Breaking a deal costs a lot of reputation.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Reputacion: How others see you. Breaking deals lowers it; with a bad name fewer colonists arrive and mercenaries distrust you.
IGUI_WQ_Dipl_SinOtras: There are no other factions yet.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Propuestas: What other factions propose to you. They expire if you do not answer.
IGUI_WQ_Com_EnGuerra: You are at war with %1: no trade.
IGUI_WQ_Com_NoTienes: You do not have %1 in a loaded base.
IGUI_WQ_Com_Fallo: The deal with %1 fell through: someone was missing what they promised.
IGUI_WQ_Com_Aceptada: Deal closed with %1: the caravans are on their way
IGUI_WQ_Com_NoEmboscar: You can only ambush caravans of factions you are at war with (or heading to them).
IGUI_WQ_Com_EmboscadaSale: %1 colonists leave to ambush a caravan
IGUI_WQ_Com_EmboscadaTarde: The caravan was gone: the ambush came too late
IGUI_WQ_Com_EmboscadaGano: Successful ambush! They are bringing the cargo home
IGUI_WQ_Com_CaravanaRobada: %1 ambushed a caravan and took the cargo!
IGUI_WQ_Com_EmboscadaPerdio: The caravan escort fought off the ambush
IGUI_WQ_Com_CaravanaDefendida: Your caravan fought off an ambush by %1
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Com_Enviar: The other faction decides. If they accept, two caravans leave and can be ambushed on the way.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Com_Nueva: Barter without money: you offer something from your storages for something from theirs.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Emboscar: Your selected colonists go to intercept it. If they win, they bring the cargo.
IGUI_WQ_Merc_Hostiles: %1 want nothing to do with you.
IGUI_WQ_Merc_IdealistasNo: %1 only work for factions with a good reputation.
IGUI_WQ_Merc_NoComercian: %1 do not trade with you (not enough sympathy).
IGUI_WQ_Merc_Quieren: They charge in %1. What you buy goes to your main base.
IGUI_WQ_Merc_ConfirmarContrato: Hire %1 for %2? They guard your base for %3 minutes.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Merc_Comerciar: Their inventory is real: what you buy, they no longer have.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Merc_Contratar: They guard your main base for a while and add their strength to its defense.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Mercenarios: Groups that roam the map. Hostile ones hunt you, neutral ones ignore you and friendly ones trade.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Merc_leales: Fair price and they keep their word.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Merc_traicioneros: Cheap, but they may turn on you mid-contract.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Merc_idealistas: Cheap, but they only work for factions with a good reputation.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Merc_oportunistas: They only follow whoever is first.
IGUI_WQ_Conf_Eliminada: %1 has no territories left: its members now watch the game
IGUI_WQ_Conf_EstaProtegida: That faction is protected: nobody is online.
IGUI_WQ_Conf_SoloGuerra: You must be at war to raid or capture.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Conf_saquear: If they win, they bring back part of what is stored.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Conf_capturar: If they win by a lot, the base becomes yours. Otherwise they still raid.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Conf_eliminar: If they win by far, the base disappears. Otherwise they still raid.
IGUI_WQ_Conf_SinObjetivo: The base was gone: the group is coming back
IGUI_WQ_Conf_AsaltoCancelado: The attack on %1 was called off: it can no longer be attacked
IGUI_WQ_Conf_CapturaEmpieza: Capturing %1: stay inside for %2 minutes with no defenders around
IGUI_WQ_Conf_CapturaPerdida: You left %1: the capture was broken
IGUI_WQ_Conf_CapturaDisputa: Capture contested (%1 of %2 min): defenders are inside
IGUI_WQ_Conf_EresObservador: Your faction was eliminated: you now watch the game.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Conf_Espiar: Sends the first selected colonist. If not caught, you see everything they have.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Conf_Capturar: Stay inside for a few minutes with no defenders around and the base becomes yours.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_lugares: Important places show up on the map. Put a territory over one and it gives you resources and points.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_guerra: At war: pick colonists on the map and right click an enemy base.
IGUI_WQ_Vic_NadieGano: Nobody won: the game ended by %1
IGUI_WQ_Vic_Req_radio: Military radio contact (radio tower or military base)
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Vic_Req_radio: Control a radio tower or a military base. If none is known on the map yet, the Radio work counts.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Vic_Req_helipuerto: Settlement-level work in the Works tab.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Vic_Req_colonos: People to evacuate, counting all your bases.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Vic_Req_recursos: Paid when you start, from loaded bases.
IGUI_WQ_Vic_ExodoPerdido: %1 lost its helipad: the evacuation falls apart
IGUI_WQ_Vic_ExodoListo: The evacuation of %1 is ready! The helicopter arrives in %2 minutes
IGUI_WQ_Vic_CuentaEmpieza: %1 meets %2! If it holds for %3 minutes, it wins
IGUI_WQ_Vic_CuentaCortada: %1 no longer meets %2: the countdown stops
IGUI_WQ_Vic_Presion: The military will evacuate the area in %1 minutes: crises will come more often
IGUI_WQ_Vic_Leyenda: Marks at the bottom: battles won (winner's color). Red lines: eliminated factions.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Vic_IniciarExodo: Pays the supplies and starts the evacuation. Everyone sees it advance and can sabotage it.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Vic_Tiempo: If nobody wins before the limit, the military evacuates the area and whoever is first wins.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Vic_Puntos: Territories, levels, colonists, wealth, places, complete cities and battles won.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Vic_exodo: Finish the evacuation first and hold the helipad until the helicopter arrives.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Vic_dominacion: Control most of the important places, or eliminate the other factions.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Vic_economia: Reach the wealth goal first and keep it.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Vic_Cuentas: Meeting a condition does not win right away: you must hold it until the countdown reaches zero.
IGUI_WQ_Pista_objetivos: Check the Objectives tab: there are three ways to win and the table above shows who is first.
IGUI_WQ_Ficha_Desde: In the colony for %1 min · %2 jobs
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Ficha_Desde: How long they have been with you and how many work cycles they have done.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Rasgos: Their personality: changes what they produce, what they eat, their mood and how they fight.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_Ficha_Estado: With the Bandits mod, their body goes to their workplace; a map order overrides that.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_RasgoColono_valiente: Defends better and risks less on trips.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_RasgoColono_cobarde: Defends worse and is in more danger on trips.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_RasgoColono_gloton: Eats 30% more, but food makes them happy.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_RasgoColono_pesimista: Their mood rises slowly, but they work a bit more.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_RasgoColono_sociable: Happier in bases with many people.
IGUI_WQ_Ayuda_RasgoColono_solitario: Works more, but gets fed up in crowded bases.
